sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: rules of the road, part two
Knowledge facts: part C holds 47 fact blocks (sec09-F01 onward) from physical pages 70 to 81; part C2 holds 51 confusable and continuation blocks (sec09-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-ROADTWO-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-ROADTWO-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-ROADTWO-D-CURB — painted curb colors appear only in a picture, so color-to-rule mapping is unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- TN-ROADTWO-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-ROADTWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: local U-turn bans, reserved and HOV lane hours, the handicap parking fine and meter rules (for example sec09-F20, sec09-R15, sec09-R23, sec09-R50) can change or vary by place and must be refreshed from official Tennessee sources and posted signs.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.
